justification: The atrium's route never moves the cart leftwards: it goes up column 1 to the button, back down column 1, rightwards along the lower rows to the door, down through the teleport into (7,6), and up column 6 to the goal at (2,7) by a final rightward step. Forbidding LEFT therefore removes a command the winning sequence does not contain, and the sequence still wins.
notes: The near-twin of the forbidden-DOWN item on the same board: the same operator, an action the solution does not need.
